features.quote: 해양생물은 돌고래 범고래 물개 상어 가오리 해파리 바다거북이 등이있고

features.name: wandering ambient population
features.notes: Shopkeepers, crowds, ambient animals, and a notable visitor figure
features.quote: Ambient Population: The non-hostile characters who inhabit the space — shopkeepers, wandering crowds, ambient animals, a named figure players come to see
